name: Michael Silberstein
abstract: What could it possibly mean to say that phenomenal consciousness is somehow extended? While one can understand how cognition can be “outside the head,” what could this mean for consciousness without resorting to panpsychism or some such? It seems absurd to say for example that consciousness is lurking about in the external world.
